name: National Metallurgist Award
teBrief: ఈ పథకం కింద, అత్యుత్తమ లోహశాస్త్ర సహకారాలు గుర్తించబడతాయి మరియు కార్యకలాపాలు, పరిశోధన మరియు అభివృద్ధి, వ్యర్థాల నిర్వహణ మరియు ఇంధన పరిరక్షణలో శ్రేష్ఠత ప్రోత్సహించబడుతుంది.
brief: Under this scheme, outstanding metallurgical contributions are recognized, and excellence in operations, R&D, waste management, and energy conservation is promoted.
briefFull: Under this scheme, outstanding metallurgical contributions are recognized, and excellence in operations, R&D, waste management, and energy conservation is promoted.
details:
The National Metallurgist Award, instituted by the Ministry of Steel, Government of India, is open only to Indian nationals who have made significant contributions to the field of metallurgy in India through their work in industry, research and development, or academia. The award recognizes outstanding achievements in areas such as operations, research and development, waste management, and energy conservation. Individuals from industry as well as research and academic institutions are eligible to apply. The awards will be presented in the following four categories:
1) Lifetime Achievement Award
2) National Metallurgist Award
3) Young Metallurgist
a) Environment b) Metal Science
4) Award for R&D in Iron & Steel Sector
**No. of Awardees**

1. Lifetime Achievement Award – 1 awardee
1. National Metallurgist Award – 1 awardee
1. Young Metallurgist (Environment Science) – 1 awardee
1. Young Metallurgist (Metal Science) – 1 awardee
1. Award for R&D in Iron & Steel Sector – 1 awardee
benefits:
1. Lifetime Achievement Award – Certificate + Memento
1. National Metallurgist Award – Certificate + Memento
1. Young Metallurgist (Environment Science) – ₹1,00,000/- + Certificate + Memento
1. Young Metallurgist (Metal Science) – ₹1,00,000/- + Certificate + Memento
1. Award for R&D in Iron & Steel Sector – ₹1,00,000/- + Certificate + Memento
eligibility: 1. **Lifetime Achievement Award:** The applicant/nominee should have at least 20 years of experience, be minimum 50 years of age, and hold a Bachelor’s degree in Metallurgical Engineering/Materials Science or equivalent.1. **National Metallurgist Award:** The applicant/nominee should have at least 15 years of experience, be minimum 40 years of age, and hold a Bachelor’s degree in Metallurgical Engineering/Materials Science or equivalent.1. **Young Metallurgist (Environment Science):** The applicant/nominee should have at least 5 years of experience, be maximum 35 years of age, and hold a Bachelor’s degree in Metallurgical Engineering/Materials Science or equivalent.1. **Young Metallurgist (Metal Science):** The applicant/nominee should have at least 5 years of experience, be maximum 35 years of age, and hold a Bachelor’s degree in Metallurgical Engineering/Materials Science or equivalent.1. **Award for R&D in Iron & Steel Sector:** The applicant/nominee should have at least 10 years of experience, be minimum 35 years of age, and hold a Bachelor’s degree in Metallurgical Engineering/Materials Science or equivalent.
howToApply:
[Online]
**Registration:**
**Step 1:** Visit the o[fficial website](https://awards.gov.in/) and click on the[ Registration button.](https://awards.gov.in/Registration/SignUp)
**Step 2:** Select your category: Individual or Organization.
**Step 3:** Fill in the required details:
Individual: Name, Date of Birth, Nominator Type, Mobile, Email, Aadhaar Number.
Organization: Type, Authorized Person Name, Date of Birth, Organization Description, Designation, Mobile, Email, Aadhaar Number.
**Step 4:** Click Submit to complete registration.
**Apply:**
**Step 1:** [Log in](https://awards.gov.in/Login) to the portal using your registered credentials.
**Step 2:** Select the scheme from the list of awards and click "Nominate / Apply Now".
**Step 3:** Fill in all mandatory fields in the online application form.
**Step 4:** Click Submit to complete your application.
documentsRequired:
1. Proof of Age
1. Details of contributions
1. Supporting evidence
1. Nomination form
1. Declarations

faqs.q: What is the National Metallurgist Award?
faqs.a: It is an award by the Ministry of Steel to recognize outstanding contributions in metallurgy in India.

faqs.q: Who can apply for this award?
faqs.a: Only Indian nationals working in industry, R&D, or academia.
faqs.qTe: ఈ అవార్డు కోసం ఎవరు దరఖాస్తు చేసుకోవచ్చు?

faqs.q: What is the minimum experience required?
faqs.a: It varies by category: 5–20 years depending on the award.
Yes, it depends on the category: minimum 35–50 years or maximum 35 years for Young Metallurgist.
Minimum: Bachelor’s degree in Metallurgical Engineering/Materials Science or equivalent.

faqs.q: What is the prize for the award?
faqs.a: Some awards include ₹1,00,000, certificate, and memento; others include certificate and memento only.

faqs.q: How is the selection process conducted?
faqs.a: Two-tier system: Screening Committee evaluates eligibility, and Selection Committee assigns marks and finalizes awardees.

faqs.q: Who are members of the Screening Committee?
faqs.a: Sectoral experts from industry, research organizations, and academic institutions.
Secretary, Ministry of Steel, along with other senior officials and sectoral experts.
Yes, individuals can apply directly through self-nomination.

faqs.q: Is prior recognition or award necessary?
faqs.a: No, but supporting evidence of contributions strengthens the application.

faqs.q: What areas of work are recognized?
faqs.a: Operations, research & development, waste management, and energy conservation in metallurgy.

faqs.q: Are nominees from all sectors of metallurgy eligible?
faqs.a: Yes, including iron & steel, environment, and metal science.
faqs.qTe: లోహశాస్త్రంలోని అన్ని రంగాలకు చెందిన నామినీలకు అర్హత ఉందా?
